integrity: The all-size theorem follows from an explicit graded-equivariant Boolean algebra argument and Young rule. The finite exact-arithmetic checker supplements and does not certify the proof or historical priority.
limitations: Complex characteristic zero only. No module-multiplication matrices, full free resolution, or positive-characteristic classification. The non-equivariant Hilbert function and the four-variable Cayley cubic example overlap known nodal Jacobian results and are not claimed as novel.
title: Multiplicity-free two-row Specht layers in the Jacobian defect of symmetric cubics
